  --text: #ececec;
  --dim: #a8a8a8;
  --faint: #717171;
  --hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  --bubble: #2b2b2b;

  --text: #0d0d0d; --dim: #5d5d5d; --faint: #8f8f8f; --hover: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.045);
  --bubble: #f1f1f1; --code: #f5f5f5; --accent: #1a73e8; --green: #1a9960; --red: #d93b2b; --warn: #c2620f;
  --invert: #0d0d0d; --invert-text: #ffffff; --knot: #8f8f8f;
  --shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16), 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  color-scheme: light;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: transparent; overflow: hidden; }
body { font: 13.5px/1.5 var(--font); color: var(--text); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
button { font: inherit; color: inherit; background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; }
svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.knot { fill: var(--knot); stroke: none; }

.card {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line-2); border-radius: 18px;
  overflow: hidden;
  animation: rise 180ms cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1);
}
@keyframes rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px) scale(.985); } }


.head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 8px 0 14px; -webkit-app-region: drag; flex: none; }
.head button { -webkit-app-region: no-drag; }
.brand { display: flex; }
.brand .knot { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
.head-actions { margin-left: auto; display: flex; gap: 2px; }
.icon { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 8px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--dim); }
.icon:hover { background: var(--hover); color: var(--text); }

.chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 28px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--dim); max-width: 210px; }
.chip span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.chip:hover { background: var(--hover); color: var(--text); }
.chip .caret { width: 13px; height: 13px; opacity: .7; }
.chip svg:first-child:not(.caret) { width: 15px; height: 15px; }


.thread { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 4px 16px 12px; scroll-behavior: smooth; }
.thread::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; }
.thread::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--line-2); border-radius: 8px; border: 2px solid var(--bg); }

.empty { min-height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; padding: 8px 6px 24px; }
.empty-mark .knot { width: 40px; height: 40px; }
.empty h1 { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; margin: 14px 0 4px; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.empty p { margin: 0; color: var(--dim); max-width: 300px; }
.recent { width: 100%; margin-top: 22px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; text-align: left; }
.recent-title { font-size: 12px; color: var(--faint); padding: 0 10px 4px; }
.recent button { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--text); text-align: left; }
.recent button:hover { background: var(--hover); }
.recent button svg { color: var(--faint); }
.recent .t { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.recent .when { color: var(--faint); font-size: 12px; }
.has-chat .empty { display: none; }

.feed { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.msg-user { align-self: flex-end; max-width: 86%; background: var(--bubble); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 16px; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; }
.msg-ai { word-wrap: break-word; }
.msg-ai p { margin: 0 0 8px; } .msg-ai p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.msg-ai ul, .msg-ai ol { margin: 4px 0 8px; padding-left: 20px; }
.msg-ai h1, .msg-ai h2, .msg-ai h3 { font-size: 14px; margin: 10px 0 4px; }
.msg-ai code { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; background: var(--code); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 5px; }
.msg-ai pre { background: var(--code); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; overflow-x: auto; margin: 6px 0; }
.msg-ai pre code { background: none; padding: 0; white-space: pre; }
.msg-ai a { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; }
.msg-ai a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }


.steps { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; }
.step { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 24px; color: var(--dim); font-size: 12.5px; }
.step .st { width: 14px; height: 14px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: none; }
.step .st svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; stroke-width: 1.8; }
.step.ok .st { color: var(--green); }
.step.bad .st { color: var(--red); }
.step .v { color: var(--text); flex: none; }
.step .l { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11.5px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; min-width: 0; }
.step .n { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11.5px; flex: none; }
.step .n .a { color: var(--green); } .step .n .r { color: var(--red); } .step .n .a + .r { margin-left: 4px; }
.more { align-self: flex-start; color: var(--faint); font-size: 12px; padding: 0 0 2px 22px; }
.more:hover { color: var(--text); }
.spin { width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.6px solid var(--line-2); border-top-color: var(--text); animation: spin .8s linear infinite; }
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
.task { font-size: 12px; color: var(--faint); margin-top: 2px; }

.note { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--dim); display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-start; }
.note.error { color: var(--red); }
.note.warn { color: var(--warn); }

.working { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--faint); font-size: 12.5px; padding: 2px 0; }
.working .shine { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--faint) 0%, var(--text) 50%, var(--faint) 100%); background-size: 200% 100%; -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; animation: shine 1.8s linear infinite; }
@keyframes shine { from { background-position: 100% 0; } to { background-position: -100% 0; } }


.ask { border: 1px solid var(--line-2); border-radius: 14px; padding: 12px; background: var(--raise); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.ask.danger { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 55%, var(--line-2)); }
.ask h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }
.ask .what { color: var(--dim); }
.ask pre { margin: 0; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11.5px; background: var(--code); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 9px; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; max-height: 120px; overflow: auto; }
.btns { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.btn { height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); color: var(--text); }
.btn:hover { background: var(--hover); }
.btn.primary { background: var(--invert); color: var(--invert-text); border-color: var(--invert); }
.btn.primary:hover { opacity: .88; background: var(--invert); }
.ask input { height: 32px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); padding: 0 10px; font: inherit; outline: none; }
.ask input:focus { border-color: var(--dim); }
.ask.done { opacity: .7; }
.ask.done .btns, .ask.done input { display: none; }
.ask .result { color: var(--dim); font-size: 12px; }

.changed { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 7px 8px 7px 12px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--dim); }
.changed .t { flex: 1; }
.changed .btn { height: 26px; font-size: 12px; padding: 0 10px; }


.composer { flex: none; margin: 0 10px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--raise); padding: 8px 8px 8px 12px; }
.composer:focus-within { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--dim) 45%, var(--line-2)); }
.composer textarea { width: 100%; resize: none; overflow-y: hidden; border: 0; outline: none; background: none; color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.45; max-height: 132px; padding: 2px 2px 6px; }
.composer textarea::placeholder { color: var(--faint); }
.composer .row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.seg { display: inline-flex; background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; padding: 2px; }
.seg button { height: 22px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: 7px; color: var(--dim); font-size: 12px; }
.seg button.on { background: var(--raise-2); color: var(--text); }
.composer .chip { height: 28px; font-size: 12.5px; }
.send { margin-left: auto; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--invert); color: var(--invert-text); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.send svg { stroke-width: 1.8; }
.send:disabled { opacity: .35; cursor: default; }
.send .i-stop { display: none; fill: currentColor; stroke: none; }
.running .send .i-send { display: none; }
.running .send .i-stop { display: block; }
.running .send:disabled { opacity: 1; cursor: pointer; }


.menu { position: absolute; z-index: 5; min-width: 220px; max-width: 300px; max-height: 300px; overflow-y: auto; background: var(--raise); border: 1px solid var(--line-2); border-radius: 12px; padding: 5px; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, .35); }
.menu .lbl { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--faint); padding: 6px 9px 4px; }
.menu button { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 7px 9px; border-radius: 8px; }
.menu button:hover { background: var(--hover); }
.menu button .t { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.menu button .s { color: var(--faint); font-size: 11.5px; }
.menu .tick { width: 14px; height: 14px; color: var(--text); }
.menu hr { border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); margin: 4px 2px; }


.chip.perm svg:first-child { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.chip.perm.full { color: var(--warn); }
.menu button .t .sub { display: block; white-space: normal; }
.composer .chip.model { max-width: 120px; }
.composer .chip.perm { max-width: 160px; }
